ng-01.title: Muhlat rabt NIN-SIM 30 Sep
ng-01.body: Khutut al-hatif ghayr al-murabta bi-raqam al-ta3rif al-watani (NIN) satuhzar min 30 September 2026. Al-rabt majjani. Yumkinuka al-rabt fi manfadh shabakatik, aw bi-ittisal bi-ramz NIN lil-shabaka, aw 3abr tatbiq NIMC. Al-khutut al-murabta la tahtaj ayy ijarah.
ng-01.action: Ittasil bi *996# (MTN), *121*1# (Airtel) aw zur ayy manfadh shabaka ma3a warqat NIN. La tadfa3 li-ayy shakhs.

ng-02.title: Taqsir 7azr al-tajawwul fi Kano
ng-02.body: 7ukumat wilayat Kano qassarat 7azr al-tajawwul fi baladiyyat Kano wa Nassarawa LGA. Al-7azr al-an min 10pm ila 5am, badalan min 7pm ila 6am, min al-arbi3a 16 September. Al-7araka kharij hadhihi al-awqat masmu7a. Al-tafteesh al-amni mustamir 3ala al-taqatu3at al-ra'isiyya.
ng-02.action: I7mil al-hawiyya ba3d al-zalam. Balligh 3an al-ta3arruz 3ind al-naqat ila Hay'at al-Shakawi al-3amma, Kano: 0803 000 0000.

ng-04.title: Tanbih fayadan Lagos 19-21 Sep
ng-04.body: NiMet tatawa3 bi matar ghadira fi Lagos min al-jum3a 19 ila al-ahad 21 September. Mantaq Ajegunle, Ikorodu, Lekki wa Ajah qad taghraq. LASEMA tansah al-sukkan bi tanzif al-majari, raf3 al-ashya al-thamina 3an al-ard wa tajannub al-qiyada fi al-ma al-rakid.
ng-04.action: Ittasil bi LASEMA 3ala 767 aw 112 idha ihtajazt. Intaqil ila makan murtafi3 mubakkiran idha ghariqat shari3uk fi Yulyuz.

ng-05.title: Tanbih 3an al-kulira fi 5 wilayat
ng-05.body: NCDC: tazayud halat al-kulira fi Bauchi, Borno, Kano, Lagos wa Zamfara. Al-3alamat: ishal ma'i mufaji' wa qay'. Ishrab ma' maghli aw mu3alaj faqat, ighsil yadayk bis-sabun, wa itbukh at-ta3am jayyidan. Al-3ilaj fi al-marakiZ as-sihhiyya al-7ukuma majjani.
ng-05.action: Ibda' bi-mahalil al-juaf al-famawiyya (ORS) fauran wa idhhab ila aqrab markaz sihhi awwali. Khat NCDC majjani: 6232.

ng-07.title: Tasjil al-nakhkhibin yubda 22 Sep
ng-07.body: INEC: al-tasjil al-mustamir lil-nakhkhibin yubda yawm al-ithnayn 22 September fi jami3 makatib al-LGA. al-nakhkhibun al-judud 18 sana wa akthar, man intaqala, wa man faqada kartuh aw talafah yumkinuhum al-tasjil. al-tasjil majjani wa yastaqriq 20 daqiqa.
ng-07.action: Idhhab ila maktab INEC fi al-LGA bi-ayy ID yubayyin tarikh miladik. La yujad ayy daf3.

ng-09.title: Jos: ijtima3 salam al-salam al-sabt
ng-09.body: Wikalat bina' al-salam fi Plateau tad3u ila ijtima3 mushtarak li-ahya' Jos North yawm al-sabt 20 September fi qa3at Jos North LGA, al-sa3a 10 sabahan. Al-ijtima3 sa-yunish al-tawatturat al-akhira 3an al-ard fi Angwan Rukuba wa al-ittifaq 3ala al-istikhdam al-mushtarak li-suq Farin Gada.
ng-09.action: Ru'asa' al-ahya' wa qadat al-shabab yajib an yahduru. Ayy shakhs yumkinuh irsal shaka bisabq 3abr khayar al-tabligh fi hadha al-khat.

ke-02.title: Tasjil al-da3m al-naqdi li-jafaf Turkana
ke-02.body: Hay'at al-idara al-wataniyya li-l-jafaf tusajjil al-usar fi Turkana Central wa Loima wa Turkana North li-l-tahwil al-naqdi min September ila November. Al-tasjil fi makatib al-ward min 17 ila 24 September. Al-usar al-musajjala tastalam KSh 5,400 kull shahr 3abr M-Pesa.
ke-02.action: Idhhab ila maktab al-ward ma3ak al-ID wa ID shakhs baligh akhar min al-usra. Al-tasjil majjani.

ke-03.title: Jalasat mizaniyat Nairobi hadha al-usbu3
ke-03.body: Muhafazat Nairobi tan3aqid muntadayat musharaka 3amma 3an al-mizaniya al-takmiliya 2026/27 fi jami3 al-muhafazat al-far3iya al-17 min 18 ila 23 September. Yumkin lil-muqimin su'al 3an al-infaq 3ala al-ma', al-turuq wa al-sihha wa iqtirah taghyirat. Tuqbal al-mudakhalat al-maktuba aydan.
ke-03.action: Uhudur muntada muhafazatak al-far3iya fi maktab al-muhafaza, 9am. Aw arsil ra'yak ila katib majlis al-muhafaza qabl 23 September.

cd-01.title: Goma: naql mawqi3 Bulengo
cd-01.body: OCHA wa UNHCR yu2akkidan anna al-usar fi mawqi3 Bulengo sa-yu3rad 3alayhim naql ikhtiyari ila Sake min 20 September. al-naql wa 3iddat al-3awda majjaniyyan. La yujbar ahad 3ala al-intiqal, wa tawzi3 al-ghidha2 fi Bulengo yastamir hatta nihayat September.
cd-01.action: Tahaddath ma3 lajnat al-mawqi3 aw maktab UNHCR 3ind madkhal al-mawqi3. La tadfa3 li-ayy shakhs muqabil makan fi al-naql.

sd-01.title: 7amla tat3im did al-kulira
sd-01.body: Wizarat al-sihha al-ittihadiyya ma3 WHO tushaghghil 7amla tat3im did al-kulira 3an tariq al-fam fi wilayat al-Jazira, al-Khartum wa al-Bahr al-Ahmar min 18 ila 25 September. Al-liqah majjani li-kull man 3umruhu a3la min sana wahida. Al-firaq ta3mal min al-marakiZ al-sihhiyya, al-masajid wa al-aswaq.
sd-01.action: Idhhab ila aqrab markaz sihhi aw intabih li-i3lan al-fariq al-mutanaqqil. Jur3a wahida takfi fi hadhihi al-7amla.

mz-01.title: Cabo Delgado: 3awdat wa da3m
mz-01.body: IOM: al-3a'ilat al-3a'ida ila Mocimboa da Praia wa Macomia tastati3 al-tasjil li-hazma 3awda: mawad iwa' wa hissa ta3am li-thalathat ashhur. al-tasjil fi maktab idarat al-mantiqa. al-turuq ila Macomia maftuha, lakin is'al al-idara al-mahalliya qabla al-safar.
mz-01.action: Sajjil fi maktab idarat al-mantiqa bi-bitaqat al-nuzuh. al-musa3ada majjaniya. Ittasil bi-Linha Verde 1458 li-al-tabligh 3an al-mashakil.

ng-03.title: Nuqtat tawzi3 al-ghidha fi Maiduguri intaqalat
ng-03.body: Tawzi3 WFP al-shahri lil-ghidha li-mukhayyam Bakassi wa Teachers Village intaqala ila mal3ab madrasat Muna Garage al-thanawiyya li-shahr September. Al-tawzi3 min 18 ila 22 September, min 8 sabahan ila 3 ba3d al-dhuhr. Ahdar bitaqat al-hissa (ration card). La rasum wa la rusum tasjil.
ng-03.action: Idhhab ila mal3ab madrasat Muna Garage ma3 bitaqat al-hissa. Ayy shakhs yatlub mal laysa min WFP. Balligh 3anhu 3ala al-khatt al-majjani 0800 500 1000.

ng-06.title: Jalasat hiwar al-muzari3in wa al-ru3at fi Kaduna
ng-06.body: Lajnat al-Salam fi wilayat Kaduna satunazim jalasat hiwar maftuha li-niza3at al-muzari3in wa al-ru3at kull yawm suq fi shahr September fi maqarr al-hukuma al-mahalliya fi Kachia wa Zangon Kataf. Yumkin taqdim al-qadaya 3an talaf al-mahsil wa masarat al-ra3y wa nuqat al-miyah bidun muhama.
ng-06.action: Ahdir bi-asma al-tarafayn wa mawqi3 al-ard. Al-jalasat tabda al-sa3a 10 sabahan. Ittasil bi-al-lajna 3ala 0906 000 0000 li-ma3rifat al-tawarikh.

ng-08.title: Tat3im majjani lil-hasba fi FCT 22-28 Sep
ng-08.body: Kull markaz sihha awwali fi majalis mintaqat FCT al-sitta sayu3ti tat3im majjani did al-hasba wa al-rubella lil-atfal min 9 shuhur ila 5 sanawat min 22 ila 28 September. La yulzam kart aw maw3id. Firaq al-tat3im sayazur al-aswaq wa al-madaris aydan.
ng-08.action: Khudh tiflaka ila ayy markaz sihha awwali bayna 8am wa 4pm. Ahdir kart tat3im al-tifl in kan ma3ak.

ke-01.title: Bitaqat ID jadida: kayfa tataqaddam
ke-01.body: Wizarat al-Dakhiliya tusdir bitaqat al-hawiya al-jadida fi kull markaz Huduma wa makatib al-tasjil. Man yataqaddam li-awwal marra wa 3umruhu 18 sana yahtaj shahadat al-milad wa bitaqat hawiyat ahad al-walidayn. Badal al-bitaqa al-mafquda yukallif 300 shilin. Al-mu3alaja tastaghriq hawali 14 yawman.
ke-01.action: Zir aqrab markaz Huduma. Tatabba3 bitaqatak bi-ittisal *232#. La tadfa3 li-ayy wasit.
